dslRule:
<!id: remove.spelling.processor.from.composite>
<!description: Remove SpellingCorrectionProcessor from CompositeQuickAssistProcessor when it only leaves one other processor.
This simplifies the quick assist setup by removing an unwanted component while preserving the intended marker resolution functionality.>
<!severity: INFO>

new org.eclipse.ui.internal.genericeditor.CompositeQuickAssistProcessor(java.util.Arrays.asList(new org.eclipse.ui.internal.genericeditor.markers.MarkerResoltionQuickAssistProcessor(), new org.eclipse.ui.texteditor.spelling.SpellingCorrectionProcessor()))
=>
new org.eclipse.ui.internal.genericeditor.markers.MarkerResoltionQuickAssistProcessor()
;;
summary: Removes 'SpellingCorrectionProcessor' from 'CompositeQuickAssistProcessor' if 'MarkerResolutionQuickAssistProcessor' is the only other processor, simplifying the initialization.
